entities.summary: Lemon Gas Stadium Hiratsuka  is a multi-purpose stadium in Hiratsuka, Kanagawa, Japan. It is used mostly for football matches and is the home stadium of Shonan Bellmare. The stadium has a capacity of 15,380 spectators.
